subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama streaming treat the configured request timeout as a progress-refreshed idle timeout, matching sibling streaming transports, once real remote-Ollama proof is added?
rationale: The code change is narrow and source-backed, but it intentionally changes timeout semantics for an existing provider path and the reported runtime behavior has not been proven after the fix.

options.title: Require proof, then accept idle timeout parity
options.body: Ask for redacted live output/logs/recording from a remote or slow Ollama-backed OpenClaw run and merge if that proof confirms the path completes with the new semantics.

options.title: Keep wall-clock timeout semantics
options.body: Pause or close this PR and ask for a different proof-backed fix that preserves the existing total request timeout behavior.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept idle timeout parity
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted live output/logs/recording from a remote or slow Ollama-backed OpenClaw run and merge if that proof confirms the path completes with the new semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current history across the Ollama stream file and the guarded timeout/runtime seams that define this compatibility choice.
